schema_limitations: Inequality semantics: The schema lacks exclusive boundary flags (< vs <=, > vs >=), causing discrepancies when queries say 'below' or 'after'.
Unit definitions: revenue_min and duration_min/max lack explicit units (dollars vs millions, minutes vs seconds).
Genre routing ambiguity: Schema defines genres in CommonQuery.genres_include and in MusicQuery.playlist_genre without clear hierarchy in system prompt.
Entity title ambiguity: CommonQuery.title overlaps with MusicQuery.track_name.

questionable_ground_truth_entries.reason: Prompt Rule 7 mandates 'similar_to' for explicit similarity. Expected parse repeats 'Movies similar to Interstellar' in semantic_query while parser correctly left it empty.

questionable_ground_truth_entries.issue: Discrete boundary decrement on continuous constraint
questionable_ground_truth_entries.reason: Query 'keep the runtime below 120 minutes' expected runtime_max=119. Schema has no exclusive bound flag, penalizing literal 120 extraction.
Query 'released after 2010, with runtimes under 170 minutes' expected release_year_min=2011 and runtime_max=169.
Query 'earned at least 500 million in revenue' expected 500,000,000.0, but schema specifies no currency unit, so parser returned 500.0.

questionable_ground_truth_entries.issue: Ambiguous genre routing between Common and Music domain
questionable_ground_truth_entries.reason: Prompt Rule 2 states 'Put general constraints (title, genres, release year) into the common section', while expected parse placed genres into MusicQuery.playlist_genre.
